description: This file defines a Java class LoanStatusConverter, which implements the AttributeConverter interface to convert between LoanStatus enum objects and their corresponding integer database representations. It is used for persisting loan status information in a database within the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanStatusConverter
classes.description: A converter class for mapping LoanStatus enum to Integer for database storage and vice versa.

methods.name: convertToDatabaseColumn
methods.description: Converts a LoanStatus enum to its corresponding Integer value for database storage.

methods.name: convertToEntityAttribute
methods.description: Converts an Integer database value back into a LoanStatus enum.
